s: The article outlines a strategy for long-term skill development in AI, emphasizing a twenty-year plan, strategic tool selection (favoring fewer, versatile tools over fleeting trends), and understanding AI's value chain from raw compute to API wrapping. It touches on wealth distribution and the evolution of AI reasoning.
sub: Long-term AI skill development and 'twenty-year plan'
Strategic tool adoption and platform dependency management
AI value chain: raw compute (hyper-scalers, Nvidia) vs. API wrapping (e.g., Cursor, OpenAI)
Evolution of AI reasoning (from one-shot to chain-of-thought, local AI)
Wealth distribution dynamics and the impact of AI
